recipes.label: Purge the army
recipes.startdescription:
You are certain there are spies infiltrated among your men. For the final victory, it is better to kill a thousand by mistake than to let one go!

[This will cause three of your comrades to die at random, but will immediately reduce the infiltration value by 3 points.]

recipes.label: Purge the army

recipes.label: Ask the local forces for help
recipes.startdescription:
Local civilian inspection squads exist. Perhaps we can make use of their abilities, hoping they are not insatiable.

[This will immediately reduce the infiltration value, but local forces may sometimes demand more; failure to satisfy may result in increased cipher or resistance levels.]
